en: A colorized historic postcard shows several men, some in traditional Jewish attire, standing and sitting among tombstones on a hillside Jewish cemetery. Below stretches a bay-front city with low houses and a prominent domed mosque-like building with a tall minaret. The sea and sky are visible in the distance. Multilingual printed captions at the top describe the view as a twilight scene of the bay taken from the Jewish Cemetery in Salonica.
